title: fix(web): refresh people after setting person thumbnail
body:
## Description
- Fix stale person thumbnail after setting featured photo from the asset viewer navbar action. The people data and asset data would be refreshed right after setting the photo, but we need to handle the `PersonThumbnailReady`  event instead, because the thumbnail generation job has to be queued and finished. The `PersonUpdate` event is not really relevant AFAICT for this case.
- Migrate to new person-asset service action

The handler needs to be in the asset viewer, because it won't run and result in stale data, if the side panel is closed during event and then opened after.

The thumbail on the person's "people page" is also stale, but kind of out of scope for this PR.

## How Has This Been Tested?
1. Keep changing the featured photo
2. Different scenarios with side panel open/closed before/after setting it
